meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 把 Telegram 适配器与配对辅助代码从 channels 分支复制进项目并注册，装好依赖、构建并跑注册测试；再引导你创建 Bot、存 token、重启服务，用 4 位配对码绑定聊天。
howto.when: 当你想给项目接入 Telegram 机器人频道时使用，通常在 /setup 流程中，或之后通过 /manage-channels 手动接入时触发。

say.text: 给这个项目接入 Telegram 频道。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试。

say.text: 开始配对 Telegram，我去把 4 位配对码发给机器人。
say.note: 会运行 pair-telegram 步骤并等待匹配。

howto.what_en: Copies the Telegram adapter and helpers from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/telegram, builds and runs the registration test, then guides you through bot creation, token storage, restart and 4-digit code pairing.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a Telegram bot channel to the project, typically during /setup or later via /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel integration to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep and runs the registration test.

say_en.text: My BotFather token is 123456:ABC-..., store it.
say_en.note: Validates the format and writes it to .env.

say_en.text: Start Telegram pairing so I can send the 4-digit code to the bot.
say_en.note: Runs the pair-telegram step and watches for the code.
